_comment: Timely chat tool specs as Go's agent catalog declares them on 2026-11-09 (47 Read tools from agent.NewCatalog, plus propose_changes and resolve_target as chat/runner.go builds them). Test input for timely_tools, the tool_search measurement and the fixture recorder; the live list comes from hello.timely_tools.

tools.description: What a bot (id or name) knows now: its latest readings and findings. If the bot is on and its last check is over an hour old, it checks once first (at most once every 5 minutes per bot), which can take up to 30 seconds. It changes nothing.
tools.name: ask_bot

tools.description: Preview engine v2 placement without writing. Recurring work occurrences in the horizon are placed as blocks (not new task rows). Returns proposals (with why), skipped (reason+message), changes (add/move/remove/pin), capacity, and risks. Scores are ordering hints, not certainty.
tools.name: auto_schedule_preview

tools.description: Calendar items, overdue tasks, and unscheduled work for a day or week.
tools.name: get_agenda

from.description: RFC3339 start, defaults to start of today

timezone.description: IANA zone for dates without an offset; a timezone saved in Working hours wins

to.description: RFC3339 end, defaults to from+1 day

tools.description: One bot's settings (id or name): its watches with their rules, how often it checks and where it alerts. Read it before proposing update_bot.
tools.name: get_bot

tools.description: Unified calendar items in a date range.
tools.name: get_calendar

from.description: RFC3339 start, defaults to start of today

timezone.description: IANA zone for dates without an offset; a timezone saved in Working hours wins

to.description: RFC3339 end, defaults to from+1 day

tools.description: Per-day available vs scheduled vs planned minutes. overCapacity and atRisk are flags, not certainty.
tools.name: get_capacity

tools.description: User, workspaces (statuses, labels, custom fields), projects with stages and open/done counts, working hours, saved views, and current time. Call this first.
tools.name: get_context

tools.description: Get a document as markdown (GFM plus math, callouts, footnotes, frontmatter, [[wiki links]], mermaid/geojson/stl blocks and openui-lang live blocks). Big stl/geojson/topojson blocks and very long code show as a [kept ...] placeholder line with a short summary; keep that line to keep the block. Pass focus (what you are looking for, in a few words from the request) to read a long doc: only its sections about that come back in full, the others as one [section kept out ...] line each. Writing such a line back keeps that section unchanged; call again with full=true to read the whole doc, and do that before rewriting or reorganizing all of it.
tools.name: get_doc

focus.description: what you are looking for in the doc, in a few words; a long doc then shows only the sections about it

full.description: true returns the whole doc even with a focus

tools.description: Documents that link to this one ([[wiki links]] or mentions), with a snippet around each link.
tools.name: get_doc_backlinks

tools.description: Get one event.
tools.name: get_event

tools.description: Working-hour gaps with no events or task blocks.
tools.name: get_free_time

from.description: RFC3339 start, defaults to start of today

timezone.description: IANA zone for dates without an offset; a timezone saved in Working hours wins

to.description: RFC3339 end, defaults to from+1 day

tools.description: For each goal, the open Work that moves it forward, as on Today. Needs smart suggestions; available=false means they are off.
tools.name: get_goal_progress

tools.description: Reminder, digest, planning, and quiet-hours preferences.
tools.name: get_notification_settings

tools.description: Get a project with stages, progress, and a stage board (Unstaged + stg_ columns).
tools.name: get_project

tools.description: Engine controls: breakMinutes, freezeHours (near-term blocks the engine will not move), excludedWorkspaceIds.
tools.name: get_schedule_settings

tools.description: Get a sheet: every tab as a markdown table (tab name and tabId, A1 column letters, row numbers; blank rows left out) with each tab's columns. With tabId (a tab id or name such as "October"), or for a one-tab sheet, also that tab's raw grid: row ids, formats, frozen panes and colour rules. Formulas start with = and use A1 coordinates per tab (data starts at row 1, headers excluded). Ranges: N2:N21 (bounded), N:N (whole column), 2:2 (whole row), N2:N (row 2 onward), B2:2 (column B onward); whole and open ranges include future rows. $A$1 and mixed A$1/$A1 refs stay put when a formula is copied. Other tabs: =January!H2, ='Jan Spend'!A1, =SUM(January!H2:H); an unknown tab gives #REF!. Operators: + - * / ^ % & = <> < > <= >=; text compares ignore case; date + 7 and date - date work in days. Functions: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, PRODUCT, COUNT, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK, MEDIAN, STDEV, LARGE, SMALL, RANK, SUMPRODUCT; SUMIF, SUMIFS, COUNTIF, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIF, AVERAGEIFS, MAXIFS, MINIFS (criteria like ">1000", "<>", "groceries", or a date); IF, IFS, IFERROR, IFNA, SWITCH, CHOOSE, AND, OR, NOT, ISBLANK, ISNUMBER, ISTEXT, ISERROR; VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX, MATCH, ROWS, COLUMNS; ABS, ROUND, ROUNDUP, ROUNDDOWN, INT, MOD, POWER, SQRT, CEILING, FLOOR; LEN, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, FIND, SEARCH, SUBSTITUTE, REPLACE, TRIM, UPPER, LOWER, PROPER, CONCAT, TEXTJOIN, VALUE, TEXT; TODAY, NOW, DATE, YEAR, MONTH, DAY, WEEKDAY(date[,type]) (1=Sun..7=Sat; type 2 = 1=Mon..7=Sun), WEEKNUM, DAYS(end,start), DATEDIF, EDATE, EOMONTH, WORKDAY, NETWORKDAYS. TEXT(value,format) takes date tokens dddd/ddd (weekday name), mmmm/mmm (month name), yyyy, mm, dd, so =TEXT(A1,"dddd") gives the weekday of a date cell. Use SUM to add ranges: =B5+SUM(N2:N), not =B5+N2:N. Keep a formula cell outside its own range to avoid #CYCLE!. Formulas are stored verbatim; get_sheet and the edit tools return raw formulas, and get_sheet_values returns the worked-out values (it can also work out a one-off formula). References follow inserted and deleted rows and columns and renamed tabs, as in the apps: delete_sheet_rows and delete_sheet_column rewrite formulas on every tab, and references to deleted cells become #REF!. update_sheet stores grids as sent, so rewrite formulas yourself there.
tools.name: get_sheet

tabId.description: one tab's grid with row ids: a tab id or the tab's name such as "October"; empty shows every tab as markdown with each tab's columns

tools.description: Get one sheet template, saved or built in (such as builtin:yearly-expenses).
tools.name: get_sheet_template

tools.description: Read a sheet's worked-out values, the numbers and text the apps show (formulas already calculated), to answer questions about its data: totals, what was bought where, the biggest buy. Every tab, or one with tabId (a tab id or name such as "October"), as a markdown table with row numbers; rows without an entry are left out. Pass formula to work out one formula without saving it, e.g. =SUMIF(January!C2:C,"Groceries",January!H2:H) or =COUNTIF(D2:D,"Keells"). Dates come back as YYYY-MM-DD and percent columns as fractions. Read-only; use get_sheet for formulas and ids before editing.
tools.name: get_sheet_values

formula.description: work out one formula without saving it, e.g. =SUMIF(C2:C,"Groceries",H2:H) or =SUM(January!H2:H); references without a tab read tabId's tab

tabId.description: tab id from get_sheet, or the tab's name such as "October"; empty shows every tab, or works the formula out on the first tab

tools.description: Get a task with blocks, recurrence, checklist, progress, and recent activity.
tools.name: get_task

tools.description: Today view: scheduled items, overdue, inbox count, today-focus set, active focus, completed today, and unfinished scheduled work.
tools.name: get_today

tools.description: Today's smart suggestions, as on Today: focus picks with their reasons and goal, the next free gap with the Work that fits it, and how many top tasks move each goal. available=false means smart suggestions are off.
tools.name: get_today_suggestions

tools.description: Weekly availability template.
tools.name: get_working_hours

timezone.description: IANA timezone fallback, same as HTTP ?tz=

tools.description: Get one workspace.
tools.name: get_workspace

tools.description: What the bots found, newest first: the findings board. bot (id or name) keeps one bot's; since is RFC 3339; limit is at most 100 (default 50).
tools.name: list_bot_findings

bot.description: bot id or name; all bots when left out

since.description: RFC 3339; only findings from then on

tools.description: The person's bots: status, schedule, health and each watch with its rules, a short summary of its last reading and, for a shop page, whether it can be bought (availability).
tools.name: list_bots

tools.description: Saved versions of a document, newest first: id, title, words, reason and when it was edited. current marks the version matching the doc now.
tools.name: list_doc_versions

tools.description: List active documents by default. archived=true lists the archive; archived=false is the default.
tools.name: list_docs

tools.description: List all calendar events (no date filter). Use get_calendar for a date range.
tools.name: list_events

tools.description: Focus sessions that ended between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, both days included, in the account's timezone), oldest first, with task name and minutes. taskId keeps one task's sessions.
tools.name: list_focus_sessions

tools.description: The person's goals (up to five, in their own words and order), shown on Today.
tools.name: list_goals

tools.description: The person's daily habits with whether each is done today, its current streak in days and the last seven days (oldest first). Today is the account's date unless today (YYYY-MM-DD) is given.
tools.name: list_habits

today.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the account's today

tools.description: List unprocessed inbox items.
tools.name: list_inbox

tools.description: In-app notifications, newest first. unread=true lists only unread.
tools.name: list_notifications

tools.description: List projects with open/done/progress summaries. Optional filters: workspaceId, statusId, completed.
tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: List the person's saved sheet templates and the built-in ones (builtins, such as builtin:yearly-expenses). Pass an id to create_sheet.
tools.name: list_sheet_templates

tools.description: List active sheets by default (title, id and each tab's name, id and size, no cell data). archived=true lists the archive.
tools.name: list_sheets

tools.description: Open Work with no edits, comments or upcoming blocks for three weeks, oldest first, with idle days and a verdict when one is clear (actionable, clarify, blocked or obsolete). available=false means smart suggestions are off.
tools.name: list_stale_work

tools.description: Saved task views (list, kanban board or gantt timeline) with their filters and which one is active. In chat from the phone app these are the phone's own views (list and board only); otherwise the web and desktop views. viewsOn in the result says which.
tools.name: list_task_views

tools.description: List work tasks. Reminders and inbox items are hidden unless reminders=true, kind=inbox, or inbox=true. Filters: workspace, project, status, labels, priority, stage, completed, overdue, scheduled, recurring, text.
tools.name: list_tasks

reminders.description: true lists duration-0 reminders instead of work tasks

tools.description: List workspaces with statuses, labels, and custom fields.
tools.name: list_workspaces

tools.description: Find the tasks a bulk edit is about from a description in words ("everything about the website launch"). Searches up to 40 nearby tasks and, when smart suggestions are on, checks each one: matches clearly fit, unsure ones need the person's or your judgement, clear misses are left out. Without smart suggestions every candidate comes back unchecked. Read-only; pass the ids you keep to bulk_update_tasks.
tools.name: pick_tasks

description.description: the group of tasks in the person's words, e.g. everything about the website launch

tools.description: Read up to 5 watches once, the way a bot would, and say what each reads right now: the price (with availability on a shop page: in_stock, out_of_stock, preorder, backorder, limited, discontinued or unknown), the text of the part, or the newest feed items. On a shop page it also lists the other prices it found, each with a selector for read=selector_price. Saves nothing. Use only addresses the person gave you or that you found for them; never put private details in an address.
tools.name: preview_bot

watches.description: 1 to 5 watches to read once, as create_bot takes them

currency.description: price watches only: the quote currency, like USD. Leave it out for a page; its currency is read from the page

id.description: update_bot: the id of a watch to keep

read.description: page: text (default), selector, product_price, or selector_price (the price in the part a selector picks)

rules.description: when to alert; left out gets a default

kind.description: any_change, above, below, move_pct (any price: price watches and pages read as product_price or selector_price); in_stock (product_price pages: alert when the page says it can be bought again); words_appear, words_disappear (page text); new_item (feeds)

onlyInStock.description: product_price pages: price rules stay quiet while the page says it is out of stock or discontinued, and alert once it can be bought (default true); false alerts on the price whatever the stock

percent.description: the move in percent for move_pct

resetPercent.description: above/below: re-arm once back past the line by this much, default 0.5

stepPercent.description: above/below: fire again after a further move this big, default 5

threshold.description: the price for above and below

words.description: words for words_appear and words_disappear, or to filter new_item

selector.description: page with read=selector or selector_price: a CSS selector

source.description: price: stock (US tickers like NVDA, read from Finnhub; needs the person's free Finnhub key) or crypto (Coinbase)

symbol.description: price: the ticker or coin, like AAPL or BTC

url.description: page and feed: the public web address

tools.description: Submit the entire ordered plan. Arguments are JSON objects matching the write schemas.
tools.name: propose_changes

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the language the person writes in, e.g. en, ja, es.

remaining.description: When the request needs more than 30 changes: exactly what is left after this batch (Timely continues with it automatically once this batch is applied). Empty string when this proposal completes the request.

reply.description: Answer to any question in the person's message that is not about the changes (e.g. what weekday tomorrow is); empty string when there is none. Shown as its own message next to the summary.

summary.description: What the changes do, for the person. Name only lengths the person gave: a task without one gets Timely's estimate after you write, so say nothing about its length or duration.

tools.description: Shortlist the existing items a change may be about when its name could match several, and say which one the person most likely means. Returns up to 8 candidates; a confident pick comes first and is named in pick. Read-only.
tools.name: resolve_target

name.description: The words the person used for the item, e.g. dentist appointment

tools.description: Keyword search over tasks, projects, docs, sheets, and events: exact title first, then title prefix, title substring, body substring. No embeddings. key:value terms (status:draft, tags:travel, owner:"Sam Lee") keep only docs whose properties (frontmatter) match.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Hybrid search across tasks, projects, docs, sheets, and events: keyword and embedding hits fused, so exact titles and related meaning both rank. Prefer this for most lookups; falls back to keyword-only when no embedding provider is set. Returns ranked chunks; follow with get_task/get_doc/… for the full record. key:value terms (status:draft, tags:travel) keep only docs whose properties (frontmatter) match; doc properties are also embedded.
tools.name: semantic_search

kinds.description: optional filter: task, project, doc, sheet, event

tools.description: Show what undo_schedule would change: the engine blocks it removes and the earlier blocks it restores. canUndo=false when there is nothing to undo.
tools.name: undo_schedule_preview

tools.description: Count of unread in-app notifications.
tools.name: unread_notification_count

tools.description: Ranked unscheduled and overdue tasks to do next.
tools.name: what_next

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for today's date when no Working hours are saved
